criteria.text: `load` accepts a `pathlib.Path` and parses the file it names.
`load` accepts a path given as `str` or as `bytes`.
Passing a file opened in text mode still raises the `TypeError` that says to open it in binary mode.
Type checkers accept a path argument to `load`.
Loading by path is no slower than loading from an open file.

manual.text: Timed by hand on my machine: loading `benchmark/data.toml` 100 times took 0.41 s by path and 0.41 s from an open file.

criteria.text: The README's "Parse a TOML file" section shows loading a path.
